resolution.note: krn-reader has a description; rule test requires name and description on every project agent.

title: Load the krn-reader subagent by giving it a description
body:
Outcome: every .claude/agents/*.md has name and description, so Claude Code loads it.
Why: on 2026-11-09 the session agent list lacked krn-reader; its frontmatter had no description, so the reader lane the lead skill prescribes was never available.
Proof: a rule test fails when an agent file lacks name or description.
Scope: .claude/agents/krn-reader.md, test/rules/project-skills.test.ts.
